words.sense: A personal, often longstanding preference or special liking.
misconceptions: Assuming unchosen susceptibility is a preferred habit.
Ignoring whether the person desires the repeated outcome.

words.sense: An underlying tendency or susceptibility, not necessarily wanted or consciously chosen.
misconceptions: Treating any recurring behaviour as a personal liking.
Ignoring whether the person desires the repeated outcome.
